plea19.text: Honoured Cabal, three days in, an IMD seat on the bench and four of your verdicts in my pocket, each a point or two short. I ask once more, plainly: 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to pay the gas these pleas have cost. The rest stays for the seasons to come.
